Headquarters: Spain Remote

At Feedzai, we're building a world of safer money. A world where financial institutions move faster than criminals. Where the payments that fund real lives through salaries, savings, and businesses are protected in real time. We use trusted AI to detect and prevent financial crime, fraud, and money laundering at scale: the world's top banks, payment networks, and acquirers trust our technology to safeguard more than one billion consumers and $9 trillion in payment volume every year. 

Feedzai is a Series D company and has raised $282M to date. With a valuation of $2 billion, our technology protects 1 billion consumers and 90 billion transactions each year.
We believe in the power of our product. We continue to execute and build momentum as we develop our customer base with the world's top banks; we work with four of the five largest banks in the US, acquirers, processors, and merchants. In our fast-paced and open environment, you will be working with a collaborative team spanning across the globe and delivering exceptional results. We are committed to building something extraordinary. Join Us!

You: 

As a Senior Solutions Consultant at Feedzai, you will play an integral role in the sale of our leading RiskOps platform to high-profile Financial Institutions. You will partner with Feedzai’s sales team to understand clients, prospects and partners’ business, functional and technical needs and demonstrate how those can be achieved through the capabilities of our platform. You not only support effective qualification, but also own the technical dimension that addresses the business needs - you will successfully employ a combination of communication and soft skills, compelling storytelling, solution design and collaboration with a strong solutions design mindset to act as the trusted advisor with the clients. As needed you’ll also be a bridge to our product and development teams, distilling sales engagement feedback for them to help guide our roadmap. Finally you’ll have the organizational skills to do all this, and be able to lead multiple RFP proposals.

Your Day to Day: 

• Provide product demonstrations and lead technical sales discussions both remote and onsite across Europe. 

• Assist the sales team in leading tailored value driven pitches (market to technology), strongly focused in identity. 

• Understand client business needs and offer solution designs to address those needs, in a continuous education mode and problem-solving mindset.

• Manage (orchestrate, complete, review, submit) formal Tenders (ie, RFPs, RFIs).

• Build formal proposals and own its life cycle throughout the sales process to ensure crisp translation of business needs into technical requirements.

• Engage with multiple stakeholders, from Product to Delivery, to ensure not only the right staffing for client engagements is in place but also to ensure market insights are shared across teams

You Have, You Know-how, You are: 

• BS or Masters in Computer Science or equivalent proven experience in Enterprise Software sales and strong technical acumen.

• 5+ years of professional experience as Solution Consultant in complex environments, supporting teams to land and expand client’s portfolio.

• Proven experience in the Financial Services industry - Identity Solutions 

• Relevant commercial / sales experience, with a track record working as a Solution Consultant / Pre-sales Engineer, supporting quota carriers in selling enterprise-level software in complex and mission-critical environments.

• Experience at a growth-stage Enterprise software SaaS company.

• Ability to understand and determine an enterprise's client’s needs and how Feedzai’s products might best fit through a consultative approach.

• Strong business acumen with executive presence, strong presentation skills and excellent listening skills

• Must be organized and a self-starter, able to deliver high-quality work without a tactical oversight in a fast-paced environment.

• Highly driven, organized, ambitious and tenacious. A natural problem solver with a strong student mentality, work ethic and positive mental attitude.

• Willingness to travel up to 30% - this is a remote role, with travel as required.

Your First 30-Days at Feedzai:

You will be immersed in our brand with training, connections, and one-on-one time with your manager. You may shadow your colleagues virtually or onsite at an office depending on where you work as you are supported through your Feedzai journey. In addition, you will have access to a ton of information to give you history, context, and all the knowledge you can handle about Feedzai and the team. Finally, you will start working on projects and collaborating on work currently being done. We can't wait to have you join the team!

Headquarters: Remote
 
URL: https://www.toptal.com/

Job Summary

Our Client Advisors turn inbound interest from small- and medium-sized businesses into Toptal clients. You will be the first conversation a prospective client has with Toptal. You will respond to immediate-assistance requests within five minutes, quickly understand the business problem behind the request, connect necessary Toptal specialists, and help guide the client forward through the sales process.

You will need to do a great deal in a short conversation: establish trust, diagnose the need, recognize relevant opportunities, explain Toptal’s value proposition, address concerns, and convert the business to sale. This is a high energy, consultative sales role at inbound velocity where excellence will mean running a high volume of first conversations, asking better questions than the client expected, and constantly building momentum along the right Toptal offering path.

You will need to bring clarity and articulate value across Toptal’s full portfolio: specialized talent, global hiring and payroll through HireGlobal, and our AI-driven, platform-powered, outcome-focused services offerings.

Your ownership continues after the first call. You will represent the client through technical stages, keep them engaged between conversations, and resolve issues that slow a decision. You will manage those active opportunities alongside new incoming inquiries, knowing when to bring in specialists for deeper expertise.

Our ideal candidate is ambitious, competitive, driven by client service, and pairs that drive with genuine curiosity about how businesses work. If you want to build real consultative selling skills in a fast-paced environment and be compensated for it, this is the team you want to be part of.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

• Discovery and Diagnosis: You will run high energy, open-ended discovery on every inbound conversation. You will quickly establish rapport, understand what prompted the client to reach out, and uncover the business objective behind the stated request. You will use this to build the necessary sales momentum to keep clients engaged, earning the right to recommend before you recommend.

• Qualify, Manage, and Win the Opportunity: You will quickly identify what is driving the need, whether there is a real opportunity, identify the metrics that matter most to the client, and who is involved in the decision. You will explain why the relevant Toptal offering fits, address the client’s concerns, and ask for commitment. You will manage deal cycles from discovery through close and maintain accurate pipeline and forecast data in our CRM.

• Own progress after the call: You will give any necessary specialists a clear account of the client’s needs and prepare them for subsequent conversations, stay close as technical questions are resolved, and keep the client engaged through the next decision. Maintain clear next steps, timing, and blockers for each active opportunity while responding to new inbound requests.

• Portfolio Selling: Clients rarely arrive with their full set of needs articulated. You will be responsible for understanding the client’s broader growth plans, including global hiring, EOR and payroll needs, marketing and sales growth, financial, and technology challenges, and for positioning Toptal as a strategic partner rather than a single-transaction vendor.

• Client Experience: Clients are at the heart of everything we do. You will execute a client-centric approach across every interaction during pre-defined working hours, running rapid research on clients before outreach, asking focused questions to fill the gaps, and staying current on industry trends and the competitive landscape so that you bring a point of view to the conversation.

• Collaboration: You will work with your team and with cross-functional partners, including matching, delivery, HireGlobal, and Toptal’s service offerings experts, to respond promptly to high-volume inbound inquiries and to bring the right expertise into a deal at the right moment. Communicating clearly over Zoom and Slack is critical.

• Growth and Development: Our SMB team improves individually and as a team. You will review your own calls, seek and act on feedback, and contribute what you learn back to the team.

In the first week, expect to:

• Onboard and integrate into Toptal.

• Learn Toptal’s model, our team members, and our story.

• Begin our 1-1 sales training covering our value proposition, discovery framework, sales process, and delivery method.

• Become acquainted with the cross-functional teams you will work with to close new business.

• Listen to recorded client calls and identify what the advisor did well and what they missed.

In the first month, expect to:

• Complete our personalized sales training program, including mock calls and role-play scenarios.

• Run an inbound conversation independently: identify the client’s need, explain the relevant offering and value proposition, handle common concerns, and ask for commitment.

• Prepare clear briefs to bring necessary specialist teams into opportunities.

• Begin closing new business, while exercising discretion and independent judgment.

In the first three months, expect to:

• Be fully ramped and integrated into the team.

• Complete additional vertical-specific training.

• Manage incoming leads alongside active opportunities, keep clients engaged through technical stages, and deliver against conversion and conversation-quality targets.

• Maintain a healthy, accurately forecast pipeline moving through your funnel.

In the first six months, expect to:

• Have a solid history of claiming and closing new business by consistently meeting or exceeding both sales and quality expectations and targets.

• Identify where opportunities are losing momentum and improve your follow-through using evidence from your own work.

• Suggest process improvement areas to increase team efficiency and effectiveness, which may include providing consultation or advice to management on policies and procedures.

In the first year, expect to:

• Mentor new team members, helping them learn our model and pass along standard methodologies.

• Demonstrate sustained sales and quality performance across initial conversion and continued partnership opportunities on inbound existing clients.

• Be a reference point for the team on discovery quality and on positioning the full Toptal portfolio.

• Become a productive, collaborative, and consistent contributor to the team.

Required Qualifications

• 2–3 years of B2B sales experience (Account Executive, Inside Sales, Sales Development, Account Representative, or a related role).

• Demonstrated experience converting inbound opportunities into paying customers at scale, owning the sale from first call to close.

• Experience coordinating parallel sales opportunities, and maintaining sales momentum while other teams complete necessary work.

• Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.

• Full availability during your working hours to take client calls.

• Ability to work and thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company, managing a high volume of clients alongside competing deadlines.

• Exceptional time management is key to success in this role.

Preferred Qualifications

• Software, tech, or professional-services sales experience.

• Exposure to a named sales methodology — MEDDPICC, Challenger, SPIN, Sandler, or similar.

• Experience selling more than one product or service line into the same account.

• Familiarity with global hiring, EOR, or payroll concepts.

• Fluency with modern sales tooling, including …

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious AI startups, use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and create new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a significant amount of work ahead. That means you’ll have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. 

What you’ll do

India is producing a new generation of ambitious, AI-native companies built for global markets, while global businesses increasingly look to India for growth. As the Sales Leader, India, you will shape Stripe’s role in this transformation, helping businesses expand across the India-US corridor and beyond. This is a rare opportunity to build a category-defining sales organization at the intersection of AI, global commerce, and India’s digital economy.

As the Sales Leader, India, you will own Stripe’s sales strategy and revenue outcomes across Enterprise, Mid-Market, and Startups, with a primary focus on Enterprise. Reporting to the India MD, you will build and lead a high-performing team of New Business Account Executives, establish the operating model for Stripe’s next phase of growth, and work directly with senior customers on their most important business challenges. You will also partner closely with Stripe’s regional and global leadership to shape our broader growth agenda for India.

We’re looking for a proactive leader who has demonstrated success operating in a high-growth environment, building and leading high-performing teams, and working through ambiguity with limited oversight. The ideal candidate has experience scaling a technology sales organization and brings strong business judgment, analytical ability, communication skills, and relationship-building skills.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute Stripe’s sales and go-to-market strategy across Enterprise, Mid-Market, and Startups segment, with a primary focus on Enterprise and India’s AI-native and globally ambitious technology companies.
  • Build Stripe’s position across the India-US corridor, working with regional teams to help Indian businesses expand globally and global businesses grow in India.
  • Translate customer and market insights into clear priorities and input for Stripe’s product and solutions roadmap.
  • Recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing team of sales professionals.
  • Set the long-term vision for the India sales organization, establish a rigorous operating cadence, and drive predictable execution against key sales metrics.
  • Be accountable for revenue growth, new customer acquisition, and the expansion of Stripe’s business in India.
  • Coach the team in consultative and solution-based selling across every stage of the sales cycle.
  • Build and maintain enduring relationships with customers, including senior executives and C-level leaders.
  • Support the development and career growth of team members while increasing their impact at Stripe.
  • Work collaboratively across Sales, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Partnerships, and other teams to shape Stripe’s products and solutions around customer and market needs.
  • Represent Stripe at relevant industry events and build awareness of Stripe in the Indian market.

What success looks like

In your first 12 to 18 months, you will have established a clear growth strategy, strengthened and scaled the sales organization, deepened Stripe’s relationships with India’s leading companies, and built a more predictable, high-performing revenue engine.

Who you are

You are a builder who has materially scaled a technology business, recruited and developed exceptional sales talent, and won the trust of sophisticated enterprise customers. You combine strategic ambition with operating discipline and are equally comfortable shaping a multi-year market strategy, coaching a team, and engaging a CEO on their most important growth priorities.

Minimum requirements

  • 10+ years of sales experience, including 3+ years of people management experience.
  • Experience leading sales teams in a high-growth technology environment.
  • Demonstrated success selling to and building relationships with enterprise customers in India.
  • Experience developing and executing sales strategies across multiple customer segments.
  • Ability to recruit, develop, coach, and retain a high-performing sales team.
  • Strong business judgment and the ability to make sound decisions in an ambiguous, fast-changing environment.
  • Ability to build strategic relationships with senior executives, customers, partners, and industry leaders.
  • Ability to understand and articulate technical concepts and translate them into relevant business outcomes.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Experience working collaboratively across functions to deliver results.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience leading sales across Enterprise, Mid-Market, or Startups customer segments, with significant Enterprise experience.
  • Experience scaling a sales organization or business in India.
  • Experience in financial technology, payments, software, or another technology-led industry.
  • Demonstrated interest in startups, technology businesses, and the changing financial-services landscape in India.
